item: The GET ratchet accounts for the lazy rollup build on installs with duckdb, and names its anonymous canary timer as a finding (R308)
summary: On an install with the columnar extra the first demand for a rollup builds it in a daemon thread by design, so test_every_started_thread_and_written_file_is_accounted_for was red on unchanged main there (keyword's sandbox) and green Core-only. rollup-build, map-rollup-build, rollup-canary-peak and rollup_build.json(.lock) are now ambient ONLY when duckdb is importable (which GET's window sees them depends on request order and build timing, so a per-route line would name a different innocent route per run); without duckdb a rollup thread or marker stays a failure. The bare threading.Timer in columnar.serve_canary starts as an anonymous Thread-N that no table can name: FINDING F4 routed to keyword (name it like its sibling), skipped in the monitor only while unnamed and only from serve_canary, with a test of both edges. Run under four profiles (full, no analysis, no analysis and no duckdb, analysis without duckdb): 27 passed in each; red before on the duckdb profile.
